setup: The owner's Octatrack MKII, OS 1.40C, RAM-booted on development twin 4c7eb79b of Modwerk base 0.8.1 (imageSha256 is that twin's MAIN image). The module ran as a RAM trial of the package named here, built by npm run module:dev -- midiverb --build-only from the source revision named here, the build the test procedure ran. Each picture is the unit's own LCD, read over USB by the development session's png step: 128x64 at integer scale 2 (256x128), two grey levels in an 8-bit greyscale PNG, not edited. Hardware captures, not emulator ones. The panel steps were sent by the session in the scrap project's bank C pattern 4 (pick:T2:FX2:DELAY; FUNC+FX2; LEVEL to MIDIVRB I/II; YES; FX2; then A, D and F turned).
